Let's add the RED regression tests to `WorktreeList.test.tsx` and `Sidebar.test.tsx`.

> I read this as completing performance packet `P-worktree` (findings `F-shell-02` and `F-shell-03`) - verified with RED tests, implemented in production code, verified GREEN, and documented in `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/docs/frontend-perf/fix-P-worktree.md`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`F-shell-02` (`WorktreeList.tsx`)**:
   - Replaced O(W * A) linear search (`agents.find(...)`) inside the render loop with an `agentsByPath` `Map<string, ActiveAgent>` computed via `useMemo`.
   - Extracted and memoized `WorktreeRow` using `React.memo` so unmodified worktree rows do not re-render when sibling state or parent components update.
   - Avoided redundant `displaySummary` object allocation when `summary.hasUnread === unread`.

2. **`F-shell-03` (`Sidebar.tsx`)**:
   - Changed eager `knownProjectsRef` instantiation (`useRef<Set<string>>(new Set(projects.map(...)))`) to lazy ref initialization (`useRef<Set<string> | null>(null)` with null initialization guard), eliminating the per-render array map and `Set` allocations.

3. **Receipt & Test Documentation**:
   - Recorded RED and GREEN test outputs and production change locations in `docs/frontend-perf/fix-P-worktree.md`.
